images.caption: The Greifenhainer Fließ within the vaste Spreewald Biosphere Reserve (Biosphärenreservat Spreewald)Meadows and fields near the village of Babow, district of Kolkwitz, Landkreis Spree-Neiße, Brandenburg, Germany. Fließ is a typical Spreewald term for stream or beck, so Greifenhainer Fließ means Greifenhain Stream.
